description: This file is a plugin for FullCalendar v2.2.7 that integrates Google Calendar data, providing functions to normalize sources, fetch events via Google Calendar API, and process event data including categorization based on hashtags.

methods.name: transformOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns the options object for fetching Google Calendar events, including error handling and event data processing.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting for Google Calendar API issues, logging to console and invoking error callbacks.

methods.name: injectQsComponent
methods.description: Inserts a query string component into a URL, used for timezone adjustments in event URLs.
